paite: Pathian Tapa, Jesu Khrist tanchinhoih kipat tungna,
heading: Baptispa Johan Leh Athupuak / (Mat 3.1-12; Luk 3.1-18; Joh 1.19-28)

paite: zawlneite Isai laibu in, "Ngai dih, na ma ah ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n na lampi abawlkhol ding;
gamdai a kikoupa aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite hihtang un," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
Johan in gamdai ah abaptis a, khelhnate ngaihdamna ding a kisikna baptisma thu gen in, ahong pawt hi.
Judia gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng apawt ua, akiang ah apai ua, akhelhnate uh thupha tawi in Jordan lui ah, amaute abaptis zel hi.
Johan sangawngsau mul puan in akivan a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
"Ka nung ah kei sang a thupizaw ahong pailel ahi; kun a akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," achi hi.
"Ke'n tui in noute ka hon baptis a; ama'n ahihleh Kha Siangthou in ahi ahon baptis ding," chi in agen hi.
Huai nite in hichi ahong hi a, Galili gam a Nazaret a kipan Jesu ahong pai a, Jordan lui ah Johan in ana baptis hi.
heading: Jesu Baptisna Leh Khemna / (Mat 3.13-4.11; Luk 3.21-22; 4.1-13)

paite: Tui a pan ahong pawttak in, van kihong a vakhu bang a atung a Kha hong kum amu hi.
Huan van a kipan aw hong pawt in, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi a, na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
Kha in amah gamdai ah asawl pah hi.
Huchi in Setan khem in gamdai ah ni sawmli a-om a, gamsate lak ah a-om a; angelte'n a-nna asepsak uhi.
Johan mat a a-om nung in, Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, Galili gam ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
heading: Jesu Nasep Patna Ngamanmi Li Sapna / (Mat 4.12-22; Luk 4.14-15; 5.1-11)

paite: "Ahun ahong tungta a, Pathian lalgam ahong naita; kisik unla tanchinhoih gingta un," chi in.
Galili tuipi gei anawk lai in tuipi a Simon leh Simon unaupa Andru len pai a om amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, huchi in mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
Alen uh paisan in amah azui pah uhi.
Sau lou apaileh Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unaupa Johan amu a, huaite len bawlpha in long ah a-om uhi.
Huan ama'n amau asam pah a; apa uh Zebedai leh kilohmi agoihte uh toh long nusia in azuita uhi.
Huan Kapernaum ah ava lut ua; Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh hi.
heading: Dawi Nin Pai Jesu Hihdamna / (Luk 4.31-37)

paite: Laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneitak a amau thu ahilh ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Asinagog uah dawi nin paimi khat ana om a; ama'n;
"Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Kou hon hihmang dia hong pai na hi maw? Nang ka hon thei a, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," chi in akikoukhia hi.
Jesu'n atai a, "Dai inla, asung a kipan hong pawt in," achi hi.
Dawi nin in amah a-engbawl a ngaihtak a kikou in asung a kipan ahong pawtta hi.
Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, huchi in "Hiai bang ahia le! Sinsakna thak ahi ve! Dawi ninte nangawn thuneitak in thu apia a, athu amang zel uh," chi in akihou uhi.
Huan Galili leh akim gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta hi.
Huan sinagog a kipan apawt un, Jakob leh Johan toh Simon leh Andru inn ah alut uhi.
heading: Peter Zi Nu Leh Mi Tampi Hihdamna / (Mat 8.14-17; Luk 4.38-41)

paite: Huan Simon sungnu khosik in achi ana a, ana lum a; huchi in a-omdan Jesu ahilh pah uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akhut a len in, aphong a; huchi in khosik in anuseta a, a-nna uh asepsak hi.
Huan nitaklam a nitum nung in, akiang ah damlou tengteng leh dawimatte ahon pi uhi.
Akhomi tengteng kongkhak bul ah ahong omkhawm khiukheu uhi.
Huan mi tampi natna chiteng a nate ahihdam a, dawi tampi adelhkhia a; dawite'n amah atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
Huan zingsang khovak ma tham a thou in apawt a, gamdai mun ah ahoh a, huai ah athum hi.
heading: Galili Gam Nasepna / (Luk 4.42-44)

paite: Simon leh alawmte'n anung ah azui uhi.
Amah ava muh un akiang ah, "Mi tengteng in ahon zong uh,” achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Maban khuate ah pai ni, huai a leng thu ka gentheihna ding in; huai mah ka hong pawtsan ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in thu hilh a dawite delhkhe kawm in Galili gam tengteng a asinagogte uah alut hi.
Huan akiang ah phak ahong pai a, "Na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei," chi in ama ah khukdin in angen ngutngut hi.
heading: Phak Hihdamna / (Mat 8.1-4; Luk 5.12-16)

paite: Ama'n ahehpih mahmah a, sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi.
Huchi in phakna in amah anuse pah a, ahong siangthouta hi.
Jesu'n amah akham bikbek kawm in asawlkhe pah hi.
"Kuamah kiang a bangmah gen lou ding in pilvang in; himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, na kisiansakna ding in Mosi thilsehte lan in, mite'n ahon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.

Himahleh amah apawt a, huai thu nakpitak a kikoupih in athang-zakta hi; huchi in Jesu alangtang in khua ah alut thei nawnta kei a, gamdai mun ah a-om zawta a; huan mun teng a kipan mite akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
